name: Momento Core Platform
description: Modular analytics and forecasting platform that collects, processes, analyzes, forecasts, and visualizes event streams in real time.
mission: Transform sequential event data into explainable, continuously improving intelligence.
vision: A stable forecasting core consumed by apps, dashboards, and future AI agents — not trapped inside a single application.
goals: Protect the Kernel (Round Event Model, contracts, runtime, event bus)
Evolve the intelligence layer into replaceable engines
